vulnerabilityScan.disposition: NOT remediated; recorded for the G1a/G1b reviews. The versions above are what the pinned candidate commit plus the fbdecc2 expansion resolve to. Per-finding applicability: every stdlib finding is reachable through this runtime's own server paths (e.g. cmd/runtime/main.go:172 http.Server.Serve -> crypto/x509 verification; internal/callback/client.go:503 http.Client.Do), the x/net findings through idna/http stack use, otel through the tracing exporters grpc/http paths, and grpc through the transport — none was judged non-applicable. Patch candidates are identified (x/net v0.60.0, otel v1.41.0 + exporters/sdk v1.45.0, grpc v1.83.1, toolchain go1.26.9 for the stdlib set); applying them changes the frozen graph, which the plan allows ONLY as: generate the new dependency graph, then re-run R2–R4 against it (冻结版本不是拒绝安全升级的理由；修复可改变冻结版本，但必须生成新依赖图并复跑R2–R4). R4-B does NOT touch go.mod/go.sum: any upgrade is 待用户授权升级后复跑 R2–R4, with the impact surface being x/net (transitive, 6 findings), otel exporters/sdk (transitive, 2), grpc (transitive, 2) and the toolchain patch covering the 20 stdlib findings. The stdlib findings need a toolchain patch, and the plan freezes toolchain patch versions to the execution environment. Until a fix or a non-applicability disposition is evidenced and signed, the candidate stays isolated-research only and G1b cannot pass.
